error.offline: Connection to the gPlug lost — retrying automatically.

placeholder.note: This page will be implemented by specification {spec}.
tooltip.consumption: Consumption covers the site's entire electricity use — not just the loads controllable by the EMS.
tooltip.loads: Loads are the consumers controllable by the energy management (e.g. boiler, heat pump).
tooltip.gridop: Grid-operator import is the power purchased from the grid operator.
tooltip.selfuse: Self-consumption is the share of your own PV production you use yourself — it saves the difference between the import tariff and the feed-in remuneration.
tooltip.peakload: Peak loads increase grid costs. Running large consumers at staggered times lowers the peak.
settings.scope_note: Here you configure this site (identity, loads, producers, grid connection, tariffs).
settings.select_hint: Select an entry on the left or add a new one.
settings.scale_base: Base exponent of the value (default: 0 = raw)
settings.energy_field: Energy counter field (optional, for 15-min energy and freshness)
settings.battery_hint: Signed power: positive = discharging, negative = charging. The battery is only observed — load allocation does not count its power as surplus.
settings.soc_url: State-of-charge URL (optional, e.g. a second Home Assistant entity)
settings.invert: Invert sign (device reports charging as positive)
settings.site.name: Name
settings.load.name: Name
settings.prod.name: Name
settings.prodtype.unknown_warn: Unknown type — not counted in the power data.
settings.tariff.unit_mode_note: High/low tariff will follow in a later version.
settings.err.id_duplicate: This ID is already in use.
settings.err.power: Please enter a valid power in watts.
settings.err.sensor: Sensor object must not contain whitespace.
settings.err.scale_field: Scale factor field must not contain whitespace.
settings.err.scale_base: Base exponent must be an integer between -10 and 10.
settings.err.max_power: Max. power must be a positive number.
settings.err.capacity: Capacity must be a positive number.
settings.err.bat_power: Power must be a positive number.
settings.err.soc_field: State-of-charge field must not contain spaces.

settings.err.energy_dimension: Unit must be Wh or kWh.
settings.modbus.name: Name
settings.modbus.test.title: Test a register
settings.modbus.test.hint: Reads or writes one register directly from the device, using the saved configuration. A write changes the connected device immediately.
settings.modbus.test.no_targets: No Modbus registers configured — enter free parameters.
settings.err.modbus_url: Please enter the address as IP:port (no http/https).
settings.err.modbus_unit: Unit/slave id must be an integer between 1 and 247.
settings.err.modbus_scale: Scale factor must be a number other than 0.
history.subtitle: Energy amounts and costs over time
history.table.title: History
history.chart.title: Overview
history.boundary_finer_end: Older values only available at a coarser resolution
history.partial: Incomplete — some sub-values are missing in this period.
history.tariff_note: Costs are computed with the currently configured tariffs.
meter.subtitle: Every smart-meter reading — phases, registers and raw data.
meter.stale: The meter may not be sending new data — the link could be stuck.
meter.empty: No meter data — check the gPlug integration.
meter.tip.register: Registers are the authoritative meter readings straight from the device (the billing basis) — as opposed to values derived in the browser.
meter.tip.net: Signed total power: positive = import from the grid (red), negative = export (green).
meter.tip.phases: Readings per line conductor (L1/L2/L3) of the three-phase connection.
meter.tip.reactive: Reactive power (±Q) is caused by inductive or capacitive loads and burdens the grid without doing real work.
meter.tip.cosphi: Power factor cos φ = |P| / √(P² + Q²), derived from active and reactive power.
meter.tip.imbalance: Phase imbalance = difference between the highest and lowest per-phase active power (max − min).
meter.tip.registers: Authoritative energy registers of the meter (OBIS) — the billing basis.
meter.tip.tariff: Current tariff reported by the meter
meter.tip.minmax: Extremes since the page was opened (RAM only, reset on reload). Voltage readings of exactly 0 V are ignored as decode glitches.
modbus.subtitle: Raw values of the configured Modbus registers.
modbus.empty: No Modbus registers configured – see Settings → Modbus.
modbus.raw.name: Name
flow.title: Power flow
flow.aria: Power flow: sources, house and grid with current power and direction.
flow.status_idle: Almost no power is flowing right now.
flow.status_import_pv: PV covers {pct} % of consumption · {w} from the grid
flow.prod_nodata: No live data from production — check integration/reachability.
flow.comp_batt_note: Battery energy is recorded since the firmware update — there are no battery values for today yet.
tooltip.flow: Shows where power is flowing right now: from PV to the house, to the grid, or from the grid to the house. Arrow thickness reflects the power.
kpi.incomplete: Incomplete data — too many readings are missing in this period for a reliable figure.
tooltip.kpi_autarky: Share of your consumption covered by your own production: (consumption − grid import) / consumption.
tooltip.kpi_selfuse: Self-consumption rate: Share of your PV production you used yourself: (PV production − feed-in) / PV production.
tooltip.kpi_saving: Total savings from self-consumption and feed-in remuneration.
tooltip.kpi_co2: Avoided CO₂ emissions from self-consumed, locally produced power (factor {g} g CO₂eq/kWh). An approximation.
settings.err.co2: Please enter a whole number ≥ 0 (0 hides the figure).
settings.gplug.restart_desc: Restarts the gPlug device. Active loads and the connection are briefly interrupted.
settings.gplug.restart_success: Restart triggered – the device will be briefly unreachable.
settings.gplug.wifi_note: Wi-Fi changes restart the device and briefly drop the current connection.
settings.pro.subtitle: Pro mode: edit site.json directly. The device only rejects unreadable JSON or a configuration it cannot load; every other check runs here in the browser and does not block saving. For advanced users only.
settings.pro.warn_hint: The device accepts the document anyway — a wrong value only shows up when the integration is polled.
settings.tariff.htnt_note: Optional: separate tariffs for peak and off-peak times. Leave empty to use the single tariff above.
settings.tariff.ht_windows_note: Weekdays and hours during which the peak tariff applies. Outside these windows the off-peak tariff applies. Default: Mon–Fri 06–21, Sat 06–13.
settings.tariff.win_empty_warn: Peak/off-peak tariffs are set, but no peak-tariff window is defined — the off-peak tariff applies at all times.
settings.err.rate_ht: Peak and off-peak tariffs must both be set or both empty.
settings.err.array_required: Must be an array of objects.
banner.archive: Archive unavailable: this browser does not store data (a private window, or site storage blocked). Only the last {days} days the device itself keeps are visible. For the full history use a normal window or allow site data for this page.
banner.archive_site_changed: This device reports site id «{id}». Archives of other ids are kept separately.
history.archive_gap: provisional — gap in the archive ({from} – {to}, {count} ranges)
settings.data.title: Browser archive
settings.data.desc: The device only stores the last few weeks. This browser keeps the full 15-minute history and derives history, KPIs and settlement from it.
settings.data.no_gaps: No gaps — the period is archived completely.
settings.data.multi_client: Every browser keeps its own archive. A browser that stayed away longer than the device buffers has a gap another browser may not have. Use one primary browser, or export regularly.
settings.data.unavailable: This browser does not allow persistent storage (a private window, for example). Only the data the device still holds is visible.
